description: Updates name / email / notes / service address / plan / subscriber number / metadata. An absent field is left unchanged; a JSON null clears email, notes, or planId (the nullable-clearable fields). Requires scope update:subscribers.

requestBody.name: subscriberNumber
requestBody.description: The operator-supplied external reference. Absent leaves it unchanged. It cannot be cleared: JSON null, an empty string, or whitespace only is rejected with 400 validation_failed naming subscriberNumber. A value is 1-32 characters after trimming.

requestBody.name: name
requestBody.description: Optional display name. Absent leaves it unchanged; JSON null clears it; a value must be non-empty after trimming. The 128 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: email
requestBody.description: Absent leaves it unchanged; JSON null clears it. The 255 limit is bytes of UTF-8.

requestBody.name: notes
requestBody.description: Absent leaves it unchanged; JSON null clears it. The 4096 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: serviceAddress
requestBody.description: Free-text service address. Absent leaves it unchanged; JSON null clears it; a value replaces it verbatim. The 1024 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: planId
requestBody.description: Absent leaves the assigned plan unchanged; JSON null clears it.

requestBody.name: metadata
requestBody.description: Free-form key/value metadata. A supplied object REPLACES the whole document. Absent leaves it unchanged, and so does JSON null - send an empty object to empty it. The serialized JSON must not exceed 8192 bytes (8 KiB); larger is rejected with 400.

children.name: serviceAddress
children.description: Omitted from the response entirely when not set (never returned as JSON null).

children.name: suspendReason
children.description: Present only while suspended; omitted (not null) otherwise.

children.name: suspendedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) when the subscriber has never been suspended.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Omitted (not null) when no metadata is set.

children.name: activatedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) until the subscriber's first host attach.

remote.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = json.dumps({
  "subscriberNumber": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "notes": "string",
  "serviceAddress": "string",
  "planId": "string",
  "metadata": {}
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("PATCH", "/v1/carrier/subscribers/{id}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
